qa_pairs.question: What wire color connects to pin 20 on connector C404?
qa_pairs.answer: .75 GY/GN wire connects to pin 20 on connector C404.

qa_pairs.question: Which fuse protects the radio/antenna circuit?
qa_pairs.answer: Fuse 27 (30 AMP) protects the radio/antenna circuit according to the 'HOT AT ALL TIMES' power distribution box.

qa_pairs.question: What is the wire color for the right front tweeter connection?
qa_pairs.answer: The right front tweeter uses .75 GN/YL wire.

qa_pairs.question: Where does the 1.5 RD/BK wire from the power distribution connect to?
qa_pairs.answer: The 1.5 RD/BK wire from the power distribution connects to connector S24 and continues to the on-board computer at connector C302 (accessory connector).

qa_pairs.question: What type of amplifier is shown in the diagram?
qa_pairs.answer: The diagram shows a solid state amplifier that is mounted in the amplifier section.

qa_pairs.question: Which connector designation is used for the left front tweeter?
qa_pairs.answer: Connector C405 is used for the left front tweeter connection.

qa_pairs.question: What wire color connects the left rear speaker to ground?
qa_pairs.answer: A GN/BK wire connects the left rear speaker to ground.

qa_pairs.question: What is the ground point designation shown at the bottom center of the diagram?
qa_pairs.answer: Ground point G200 is shown at the bottom center of the diagram for ground distribution.

qa_pairs.question: Which wire carries the 1 GY/BR signal in the front speaker circuit?
qa_pairs.answer: The 1 GY/BR wire connects from connector C404 to the right front speaker circuit.

qa_pairs.question: What note appears regarding some vehicles and ground distribution?
qa_pairs.answer: The note states 'SOME VEHICLES MAY CONTAIN AN ADDITIONAL SPLICE. (SEE GROUND DISTRIBUTION)' referring to the ground distribution system.
